lead.title: Kry buys Min Doktor and passes 150 physical care sites in Sweden
lead.deck: Sweden's Kry (SEK 2.5B revenue in 2025) is acquiring all of Min Doktor: nearly 100 clinics run alongside Apotek Hjärtat pharmacies and ICA stores, around 400,000 digital visits and more than 300,000 vaccinations in 2025, for revenue of about SEK 400M; the price was not disclosed. The deal is paid in shares: Apotek Hjärtat (49.5% of Min Doktor), EQT Ventures and Swedbank Robur become Kry shareholders. Subject to competition clearance, it confirms that the winning model in European digital primary care is hybrid, from the screen to the shop floor.

milestone.title: Flo Health earns ISO 13485 certification, the foundation for future medical device software
milestone.summary: The London women's health app (80 million monthly active users) had its quality management system for designing medical software, built on the Ketryx platform, audited by Scarlet, an accredited body specialising in AI medical devices; no major findings were reported. The certification opens the route to CE and UKCA marking and aligns with the FDA's quality system regulation.
milestone.why: Europe's first femtech unicorn is moving from wellness to regulated medicine: the next day it published in the journal Menopause, with Mayo Clinic clinicians, the validation of its perimenopause symptom scale (Peri-SS, 16 items, 1,255 women). A signal ahead of a first SaMD product, and so ahead of new payer channels.

brefsEurope.title: Deepinvoice raises €700K pre-seed, led by BDOC Plus AG, to automate medical billing with AI
brefsEurope.summary: Its software reads the patient record, identifies billable services and generates GOÄ, EBM and ICD-10 coding lists for private and statutory insurance, trained on ophthalmology billing. NRW.BANK (NRW.SeedCon), Dresden's Augenzentrum am Blauen Wunder and angel Burkhard Awe complete the round, which will make the product cloud-ready and extend it to other specialties.

brefsEurope.title: At Barts Health, 1,350 clinicians have already used Oracle's clinical AI agent, open to more than 2,000
brefsEurope.summary: The London trust counted 700 users in September; it is also rolling out Ovia's automated follow-up calls for its heart and lung virtual wards. In intensive care, nurse Anna Lazcano is prototyping VOCAL, an AI tool that helps patients who cannot speak build messages with their eyes or touch.

brefsEurope.title: Croydon Health Services sets its AI priorities: ambient voice in the ED, Patienteer and prostate cancer screening
brefsEurope.summary: The strategy requires a named sponsor and outcome metrics for every use, assessment through the NHS T.E.S.T framework and bias audits from Q4 2026/27, funded by productivity savings. An AI centre of excellence, ambient voice in community services and automated clinical coding follow from 2027/28.

brefsIntl.title: Elligint Health acquires Laguna Health and its conversational AI for care management
brefsIntl.summary: Founded in 2020 by Yoni Shtein and Yael Peled Adam, Laguna (Edison, New Jersey and Tel Aviv) audits 100% of health plan member calls and cut care manager documentation time by 66% at one client; it keeps its brand and stays available on rival platforms. Elligint's Helios platform covers more than 13 million managed lives; the price was not disclosed.

brefsIntl.title: ONC and CMS launch 10-to-12-week testing sprints for FHIR-based electronic prior authorization
brefsIntl.summary: Payers, hospitals, EHR developers and clearinghouses will test the Da Vinci CRD, DTR and PAS guides on Drummond Group's FHIRplace environment, supported by MITRE, ahead of the requirement for impacted payers to run prior authorization APIs by January 1, 2027 (72-hour decisions for urgent requests, seven days otherwise).

word.fr: Open standard for modelling the patient record
word.definition: An open, vendor-neutral standard that describes clinical data with models designed by clinicians, so a patient's record stays readable for life, whatever software displays it.

parts.label: Reference model
parts.role: the stable, generic technical foundation shared by every openEHR system

parts.label: Archetypes and templates
parts.role: the clinical content (a blood pressure reading, a discharge summary) defined and reviewed by clinicians

parts.label: Clinical data repository (CDR) and AQL
parts.role: storing the data and querying it through a REST API and a standard query language

how.t: Clinicians build reusable archetypes, then combine them into templates tailored to a specific use (consultation, prescription, discharge).
Applications write data into a vendor-independent clinical data repository (CDR) through a standardised REST API.
Any application, analytics tool or AI model queries the same data in AQL; FHIR often serves as the exchange layer with outside systems.

word.why: openEHR separates clinical data from the application: a hospital or region can switch software without migrating its data estate, and add analytics or AI tools without depending on an EHR vendor. With the NHS single patient record under construction, the EHDS and the race for structured data to feed AI, the standard underpins a European ecosystem of clinical data platforms positioning themselves against the big integrated EHRs.

startups.name: Better
startups.use: Better Platform, an openEHR clinical data layer (with FHIR for operational data): more than 40 million records, 1,000 healthcare organisations in 30+ countries, Better Meds e-prescribing live in more than 10 NHS trusts

startups.name: Cadasto
startups.use: Open data platform launched in early 2026 from the openEHR layer of CODE24, the first Dutch vendor to adopt the standard; an openEHR Platinum Partner offering data federation, a SMART-on-openEHR connector and an open-source MCP server for designing archetypes and templates

startups.name: vitagroup
startups.use: Develops EHRbase, an open-source openEHR repository, and its commercial version HIP EHRbase; more than 400 subscribers to its sandbox in five months (Germany, UK, Nordics, Netherlands)
